## Context / immutable basis
This reconciler-test cohort contains 24 confirmed bloated prose blocks across exactly 8 file-impact paths. Condense repetition, obvious narration, duplicated explanation, and obsolete history while retaining current non-obvious contracts.

The inventory and before-citations are pinned to `origin/main@d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1`. A path-scoped comparison through `9e6a0e436520f67962c22dc244d7b4f77f5bee45` found identical blobs. Implement from current `origin/main`; keep d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1 as the immutable before side. This leaf is one commit, so path checks use `HEAD^..HEAD`.

## Editing boundary and semantic guard
Edit only allowlisted comments/docstrings plus adjacent blank lines. Executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose stay unchanged. Rewrite stale RED/pre-fix language as current contracts.

For every path, parse immutable and final source with `ast.parse(source, type_comments=True)`; recursively strip only a leading `Expr(Constant(str))` from each `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, and `AsyncFunctionDef`; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require exact `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)` equality. A tokenizer guard separately preserves directive text/attachment; runtime strings remain AST-identical.

## Scope — 24 editable blocks
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/classify/test_frozen_census.py` (1) — module docstring beginning “Frozen-artifact census replay…”. Preserve the 615-cell composition, acting-cell arithmetic, breaker headroom, and healed-state oracle.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_alert_store_import.py` (2) — module docstring beginning “Regression tests for bug ec9a…”; docstring of test_load_alert_store_registers_under_canonical_key. Preserve lazy loading without a plugins namespace, the canonical sys.modules key, shared module identity, and retry-safe cleanup.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py` (5) — module docstring; docstrings of _isolate_alert_store_module, _DuplicatingPaginatingClient, and test_dedup_suppression_emits_alert; comment beginning “Patch the _load_alert_store SEAM…”. Preserve the implemented cross-page dedup alert, newer-timestamp fixture, order isolation, one-record snapshot, alert kind, canonical append channel, and duplicated key.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py` (6) — module docstring; _PaginatingClient and test_fetcher_calls_acli_with_split_jqls_verbatim docstrings; comments beginning “Two JQL strings emitted…”, “Pre-split, the stub used…”, and “Greppable AC token retained…”. Preserve verbatim active/Done JQLs, 1000/500 per-query pools, the 1500 aggregate AC token, 100-step pagination, caps, and explicit truncation diagnostics.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_project_scoped_jql.py` (1) — module docstring beginning “Bug 626d…”. Preserve configured-project scoping and fail-closed validation before any Jira search.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_split_jql_queries.py` (3) — module and _JqlRoutedClient docstrings; comment beginning “Behavioral coverage for the three constants…”. Preserve active-before-Done ordering, per-JQL routing, active ceiling, recent-Done cap, cross-query dedup, and the rationale against constant-equality tests.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py` (3) — module and _SameTokenTwiceClient docstrings; comment beginning “Best-effort import of SilentTruncationError…”. Preserve the implemented 1200-result and repeated-token failures, below-ceiling success, and collection behavior without obsolete RED-state claims.
- `tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/fetch/test_fetcher_unmapped_status.py` (3) — module and test_unmapped_status_alert_deduped_across_passes docstrings; comment beginning “The fetcher resolves alert_store via…”. Preserve the implemented unmapped-status alert, mapped control, shared-module isolation, durable JSONL dedup, and structured status/key evidence.

## Consumers and protected directives
Pytest directly collects every impacted module; `scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py` is the deterministic prose-policy consumer. No targeted `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, or doctest consumer was found. Five protected directive tokens: one # type: ignore[union-attr] in test_fetcher_dedup_observable.py, one in test_fetcher_pagination_jql.py, and two plus the complete combined # noqa: BLE001 … # pragma: no cover … token in test_fetcher_truncation_gate.py. Preserve each complete directive token and its attached executable statement exactly.

## Independent review receipt
A reviewer who did not author the prose change must post exactly 24 leaf-linked TSV rows, one per edited block:
`path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session`

Both verdicts are `PASS`, citations use full SHAs, and every after count is lower. Missing, duplicate, or extra rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Only the 24 allowlisted prose blocks or adjacent blank lines change.
- [x] Every edited block is shorter and states only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints.
- [x] Normalized AST dumps are exactly equal between d49fea41cc383dc70d465903e94598a6dc790bd1 and final `HEAD`.
- [x] Protected directive text and attachment are exact; runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [x] Sorted paths changed by the one leaf commit `HEAD^..HEAD` exactly equal all 8 file-impact paths.
- [x] The non-author TSV has exactly 24 passing rows with full before/final SHAs.
- [x] Path-scoped diff integrity, comment hygiene, and pytest over every impacted file pass.
- [x] Worktree-venv `make verify` passes without a timeout.

## Verification
Run all seven structured commands: `semantic`, `directives`, `paths`, `diff`, `hygiene`, `focused`, and `full`. Executable guards prove behavior/directive/path preservation; the TSV decides each block’s semantic preservation and bloat removal.
